lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: YOU ABSOLUTE FOOL, NIX, YOU DISMANTLED THE ENGINE OF THE GOLDEN SCOOTER AND THREW AWAY THE TURBO CHARGER!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Relax Uncle Jamal, [beat] the engine was never the reason this scooter was the fastest thing on these dark streets at midnight.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: Oh please, [beat] I saw you sneaking out every night like a common thief, probably selling those golden parts for pocket money!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I wasn't selling anything, [beat] I was making deliveries to the neighbors who were too sick or too old to leave their houses alone!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, is that why your backpack is always full of fresh bread and [beat] emergency medicine from the local pharmacy every single evening?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The scooter didn't need a turbo charger [beat] because when you have a real purpose, the road ahead just seems to clear itself out for you.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: It is true, Nix saved my family's dinner last week [beat] and he didn't even ask for a single cent in return for the help he gave us!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal, you spent thousands on chrome [beat] while I was spending my time learning exactly what this neighborhood actually needed from me.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I thought the gold paint made it special, [beat] but I realize now that I was just looking at a shiny machine while you were being a hero.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The best upgrades aren't mechanical, [beat] they happen in your heart when you stop racing against others and start finally racing for them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix finally understood that being the Hero of Midnight [beat] meant his golden scooter was finally worth its weight in actual gold.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Now that the secret is finally out, [beat] I think it is time we get everyone in the family a pair of wheels to help out!
